annotations.description: Passed priority in precombat main with 5 untapped lands and multiple castable removal spells. Synchronized Eviction costs only 3 mana (reduced by 2 from controlling two Faeries) and could tuck Drover of the Mighty or Drowsing Tyrannodon, while still leaving 2 mana open for Alchemist's Gift. Finishing Blow was also castable at 5 mana. The opponent has two 3/3 creatures threatening to pressure Kimi's 15 life total.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without casting any spells
annotations.betterLine: Cast Synchronized Eviction (3 mana with Faerie discount) targeting Drover of the Mighty to remove the 3/3 attacker and mana ramp, leaving 2 mana open for Alchemist's Gift as a combat trick. Alternatively, hold Eviction and plan to use Finishing Blow at instant speed on the most threatening creature.

annotations.description: Casting Alchemist's Gift during combat uses 1 Black mana, leaving only 4 mana (3 Islands + 1 Swamp) available. Finishing Blow costs {4}{B} (5 mana including 1 Black), so after casting Alchemist's Gift, they cannot cast Finishing Blow to destroy Ghalta 12/12 before it attacks. Ghalta deals 12 trample damage next turn, which is lethal against their 11 life even with a blocker.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Alchemist's Gift during combat to deal 1 extra damage (reducing opponent from 4 to 3 life)
annotations.betterLine: Pass priority without casting anything, preserve all 5 mana to cast Finishing Blow on Ghalta during opponent's next turn before it can attack. The 1 extra damage is meaningless compared to surviving a 12/12 trampler.

annotations.description: Opponent is at 4 life with no flying blockers available. Nightshade Stinger (1/1) and Sentinels of Glen Elendra (2/3) are attacking for only 3 total damage. Alchemist's Gift on either attacker would add +1/+1, making total combat damage exactly 4 — lethal. Instead, the player passed, dealing only 3 and leaving opponent at 1 life with a 12/12 Ghalta ready to attack next turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority during combat without casting Alchemist's Gift, dealing only 3 damage.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Alchemist's Gift on either attacking creature (e.g., Nightshade Stinger to make it 2/2) for exactly 4 damage lethal.

annotations.description: Player passed with 6 untapped lands and castable Brood Monitor in hand. At 4 life facing aerial threats, deploying Brood Monitor provides both additional attackers for lethal next turn and Scion tokens for chump blocking. If opponent has removal/bounce for Ghalta, Brood Monitor serves as crucial insurance.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority in postcombat main phase, ending the turn without casting anything or playing Ash Barrens.
annotations.betterLine: Play Ash Barrens, then cast Brood Monitor (6 mana available). This creates 3 additional Scion tokens for blocking and adds power to the board as insurance against Ghalta removal.

annotations.description: Failed to cast Finishing Blow on Ghalta, Primal Hunger (12/12 trample) when having exactly enough mana (5 mana from 3 Islands + 2 Swamps). Ghalta will untap next turn and attack for lethal through trample. Additionally, with Ghalta alive, Drowsing Tyrannodon loses defender and can also attack. Without Ghalta, the opponent at 4 life would have only a defender Tyrannodon and a 1/1 Blisterpod, while Kimi25's flyers could close out the game in 2 attacks.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without casting anything, ending the turn and leaving Ghalta alive.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Finishing Blow targeting Ghalta, Primal Hunger. This removes the lethal threat and likely wins the game, as the opponent at 4 life has no way to race Kimi25's flying creatures.

annotations.description: With Finishing Blow already handling Ghalta, Alchemist's Gift could have been cast on Sentinels of Glen Elendra (2/3) blocking Drowsing Tyrannodon (3/3). Giving +1/+1 makes Sentinels a 3/4, surviving the block while killing the Tyrannodon. With lifelink choice, also gains 3 life. This saves a key flying threat that can attack the opponent (at 4 life) for lethal in 2 turns, while removing their 3/3.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority, declining to cast Alchemist's Gift
annotations.betterLine: Cast Alchemist's Gift on Sentinels of Glen Elendra choosing lifelink (or deathtouch), making it 3/4 to survive blocking Drowsing Tyrannodon while killing it. Preserves the flying clock against an opponent at 4 life.

annotations.description: Casting Alchemist's Gift during opponent's combat with no untapped blockers accomplishes nothing. More critically, the opponent is at 4 life, and next turn Nightshade Stinger (1/1 flying) + Sentinels of Glen Elendra (2/3 flying) = 3 flying damage. With Alchemist's Gift on Stinger, that's 4 damage - exactly lethal through the air. Wasting the Gift here throws away a lethal line.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Alchemist's Gift during opponent's combat phase with no untapped creatures to meaningfully target
annotations.betterLine: Save Alchemist's Gift. Next turn, attack with Nightshade Stinger and Sentinels of Glen Elendra in the air, cast Alchemist's Gift on Stinger for +1/+1, dealing exactly 4 flying damage for lethal.

annotations.description: Casting Alchemist's Gift during opponent's combat on a tapped creature that isn't blocking accomplishes nothing. Wasting the Gift now throws away the win.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Alchemist's Gift during opponent's combat phase on a tapped, non-blocking creature
annotations.betterLine: Save Alchemist's Gift. Take the 4 damage (going to 7 life). Next turn, attack with Nightshade Stinger and Sentinels of Glen Elendra, cast Alchemist's Gift on Stinger for +1/+1, dealing exactly 4 flying damage for lethal.

annotations.description: At 6 untapped Forests, Brood Monitor costs exactly {4}{G}{G} and would create a 3/3 plus three 1/1 Scion tokens. With the current attack dealing 4 damage (opponent goes to 3 life), Brood Monitor's six total power virtually guarantees lethal next turn through the opponent's limited blockers. Warden of Geometries only adds a 2/3, which may not be enough to close the game against an opponent who could stabilize or race with the Nightshade Stinger.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Warden of Geometries (2/3 for {4}), leaving 2 mana unused
annotations.betterLine: Cast Brood Monitor for {4}{G}{G}, creating a 3/3 and three 1/1 Scions, presenting lethal on the next attack with the opponent at 3 life facing 6+ power across multiple bodies
